capabilities: Send notes or selections to a T3 Code agent
Stream agent replies into the note as Markdown
Import and catch up on existing T3 responses
Filter the file explorer to a T3 note inbox
Open sidebar threads, side chats, and subagent views
disambiguation: Not an agent itself; Obsidian is only a client and the plugin neither includes nor starts a T3 Code server.
extras: Free plugin, but T3 and model provider accounts or usage charges are separate. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Voice input works only on devices with browser speech recognition; T3's remote transcription service is not connected. Includes its own GitHub release update checker and banner.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to an external coding agent and get streamed replies back into the editor.

requires.name: Python 3.10 or later on each T3 computer

summary: Client plugin that connects Obsidian to a running T3 Code agent, streaming replies into notes and adding inbox and sidebar views.
